newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Fernandez asked to pressure judge-Jassan.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Fernandez asked to pressure judge-Jassan.

text.p: Argentina's Justice Minister Elias Jassan has said on television that current economy minister Roque Fernandez acted as an emissary of Domingo Cavallo in 1994 to ask him to intercede with a judge.

In a local television interview reported by the Clarin newspaper Tuesday, Jassan said Fernandez approached him in October 1994 and asked him to speak with a judge who was investigating corruption allegations against economy minister Cavallo.
Cavallo denied Jassan's charge Monday in a press conference. It was not immediately possible to contact Fernandez on the report.
According to the reported TV interview, Jassan quoted Fernandez as telling him, "Cavallo is fuming and asked for you to do something, because if not there is going to be big trouble."
Jassan added, "He asked me to manipulate judges."
Jassan was Under Secretary for Justice at the time of the alleged incident, Cavallo was economy minister and Fernandez was central bank president.
Jassan has been engaged in a fierce political war with Cavallo.
Shortly after stepping down as economy minister in mid-1996, Cavallo charged Jassan with manipulating judges, an accusation which Jassan swiftly denied.
